slideTypes.question: Opening question or proposition. Type only.
slideTypes.world: Context. What is happening culturally or commercially.
slideTypes.reference: The evidence or reference that started it.
slideTypes.tension: The contradiction. Longest and most visual slide of a project.
slideTypes.observation: What was noticed. May carry the proof object.
slideTypes.insight: One sentence on a nearly empty slide.
slideTypes.interpretation: What it means. Large type, little else.
slideTypes.idea: The position or concept. May carry a title and a definition caption.
slideTypes.expression: The world built. Carries the proof object.
slideTypes.outcome: One-line close: what changed or what it makes possible.
slideTypes.lineup: Fashion: the full collection together. Proof object.
slideTypes.client: Web: who they are and what the site had to do.
slideTypes.problem: Web: what was not working. Before and after.
slideTypes.direction: Web: what the site should feel like.
slideTypes.experience: Web: desktop and phone side by side with the URL. Proof object.
slideTypes.closing: Bio, what Zai is looking for, contact, link to the site.

statuses.draft: Copy written, for Zai to approve.
statuses.needs-input: Zai must supply content or images.

imageStatuses.needed: No file yet. Render a clearly marked placeholder.

rules: Never print act names on slides. They live in notes only.
The tension slide is the longest and most visual of its project.
The insight slide is one sentence on a nearly empty slide.
Body text on a slide stays under about 30 words. More belongs in notes.
Close every project on one line: what changed or what it makes possible.
No em dashes in any copy.
